inventory.businessPurpose: Background task queue and job processing state machine for distributed schedulers, outbox publishers, and telemetry sweeps
inventory.strategy: C (Both automatic expiration and Super Admin backup-and-purge)
inventory.recommendedRetentionPeriod: Completed jobs: 7 days after completion; Failed jobs: 30 days after last failure. Historical backlog (621k+): Super Admin backup-and-purge.
inventory.dataSensitivity: Internal operational (may contain payload entity IDs and task parameters)
inventory.riskOfDeletion: Medium: Pending or processing jobs must NEVER be purged. Purge must filter exclusively on status in ['completed', 'failed'] where completedAt < cutoff.
inventory.implementationComplexity: Medium: Requires TTL index on completedAt + backfill of completedAt on historical completed docs lacking it, plus Super Admin batch purge.
inventory.evidenceAndNotes: Top storage consumer in database: 622,103 documents, 233.6 MB data, 51.7 MB index storage.

inventory.businessPurpose: In-app and multi-channel notification records delivered to employees, managers, and admins
inventory.strategy: C (Both automatic expiration and Super Admin backup-and-purge)
inventory.recommendedRetentionPeriod: Read notifications: 30 days; Unread automated alerts: 90 days; High/critical priority: 180 days with archive option.
inventory.dataSensitivity: Confidential employee data (names, onboarding steps, manager reminders)
inventory.riskOfDeletion: Medium: Unread notifications affect user notification badges. Must ensure users do not lose active pending action items.
inventory.implementationComplexity: Medium: Existing TTL index on expiresAt (0s) is currently ineffective because 96.4% of docs have expiresAt: null. Requires automated expiresAt computation.
inventory.evidenceAndNotes: Second largest collection: 83,394 documents, 77.6 MB data, 7.1 MB index storage.

inventory.businessPurpose: Immutable audit trail of all security, authentication, CRUD, and administrative events for compliance
inventory.strategy: B (Super Admin backup-and-purge workflow with long-term retention)
inventory.recommendedRetentionPeriod: Active database: 365 days; Cold encrypted archive: 7 years (SOC2/HIPAA/GDPR compliance)
inventory.dataSensitivity: High (IP addresses, user IDs, security actions, administrative mutations)
inventory.riskOfDeletion: High: Compliance violation if deleted without verified recoverable archive.
inventory.implementationComplexity: High: Already has 7-year TTL index (220,752,000s). Requires verified encrypted S3/R2 backup before any purge.
inventory.evidenceAndNotes: 3,458 records, 1.9 MB data, 1.2 MB index storage across 15 compound indexes.

inventory.businessPurpose: Transactional outbox pattern events for reliable asynchronous event bus publishing
